properties.name: Suppression Name

properties.name: Start Date

properties.name: End Date

Creates one entity-based maintenance alarm suppression for exactly one physical server, optionally bounded by RFC 3339 Start/End dates. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations, physical summaries, and suppressions and create cond.AlarmSuppression. It OData-escapes names; requires one scoped Name-or-Serial server; permits only compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit; rejects a duplicate suppression name; and revalidates dates before POST. The payload uses a discriminator-complete Entity mo.MoRef and no AlarmRules. HTTP 2xx plus validated response proves Enabled resource creation, not that suppression is active, which also depends on StartDate/service state. Lookup and POST are separate, so concurrent same-name creates depend on service uniqueness. Generic APIs are used because no complete atomic exists.

properties.script:
import json
import sys

organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
organizationStatusCode = "500"
organizationMessage = "Organization lookup inspection did not complete."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""
organizationResultCount = -1

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The organization response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    organizationResultCount = len(results)
    if organizationResultCount != 1:
        organizationStatus = "cardinality"
        organizationStatusCode = "404" if organizationResultCount == 0 else "409"
        organizationMessage = "The organization lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % organizationResultCount
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup cardinality failure", "matchCount": organizationResultCount, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The single organization result is not a JSON object."
            organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            moid = item.get("Moid")
            name = item.get("Name")
            if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip() or not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
                organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
                organizationStatusCode = "502"
                organizationMessage = "The matching organization is missing a usable Moid or Name."
                organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
            else:
                organizationMoid = moid
                organizationStatus = "ready"
                organizationStatusCode = "200"
                organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization with a usable Moid was resolved."
                organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
    organizationStatusCode = "500"
    organizationMessage = str(exc)
    organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup inspection failed", "detail": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

serverStatus = "helper-failure"
serverStatusCode = "500"
serverMessage = "Server lookup inspection did not complete."
serverResultJson = json.dumps({"error": serverMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
serverMoid = ""
serverObjectType = ""
serverResultCount = -1

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The server response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The server response does not contain a Results array.")
    serverResultCount = len(results)
    if serverResultCount != 1:
        serverStatus = "cardinality"
        serverStatusCode = "404" if serverResultCount == 0 else "409"
        serverMessage = "The organization-scoped exact Name-or-Serial lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % serverResultCount
        serverResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Server lookup cardinality failure", "matchCount": serverResultCount, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            serverStatus = "invalid-resource"
            serverStatusCode = "502"
            serverMessage = "The single server result is not a JSON object."
            serverResultJson = json.dumps({"error": serverMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            moid = item.get("Moid")
            sourceObjectType = item.get("SourceObjectType")
            name = item.get("Name")
            serial = item.get("Serial")
            if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
                serverStatus = "invalid-resource"
                serverStatusCode = "502"
                serverMessage = "The matching compute.PhysicalSummary is missing a usable Moid."
                serverResultJson = json.dumps({"error": serverMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
            elif sourceObjectType not in ("compute.Blade", "compute.RackUnit"):
                serverStatus = "invalid-resource"
                serverStatusCode = "409"
                serverMessage = "The matching compute.PhysicalSummary SourceObjectType must be compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit."
                serverResultJson = json.dumps({"error": serverMessage, "SourceObjectType": sourceObjectType}, separators=(",", ":"))
            else:
                serverMoid = moid
                serverObjectType = sourceObjectType
                serverStatus = "ready"
                serverStatusCode = "200"
                serverMessage = "Exactly one supported physical server was resolved."
                serverResultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "Serial": serial, "ObjectType": sourceObjectType}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    serverStatus = "helper-failure"
    serverStatusCode = "500"
    serverMessage = str(exc)
    serverResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Server lookup inspection failed", "detail": serverMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import sys

duplicateStatus = "helper-failure"

    if not isinstance(payload, dict):

        raise ValueError("The alarm-suppression response does not contain a Results array.")

        duplicateStatus = "ready"
        duplicateStatusCode = "200"
        duplicateMessage = "Suppression Name is available."
        duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"duplicateCount": 0}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    duplicateStatus = "helper-failure"
    duplicateStatusCode = "500"
    duplicateMessage = str(exc)

    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The create response body is not a JSON object.")

    moid = payload.get("Moid")
    name = payload.get("Name")
    enabled = payload.get("Enabled")
    entity = payload.get("Entity")
    alarmRules = payload.get("AlarmRules")
    problems = []

    if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
        problems.append("The created resource response is missing a usable Moid.")
    if name != expectedName:
        problems.append("The created resource Name does not match Suppression Name.")
    if enabled is not True:
        problems.append("The created resource response does not report Enabled=true.")
    if not isinstance(entity, dict):
        problems.append("The created resource response does not contain an Entity relationship.")
    else:
        if entity.get("Moid") != expectedServerMoid:
            problems.append("The created Entity Moid does not match the resolved server.")
        if entity.get("ObjectType") != expectedServerObjectType:
            problems.append("The created Entity ObjectType does not match the resolved server SourceObjectType.")
    if alarmRules not in (None, []):
        problems.append("The created entity-based suppression unexpectedly contains AlarmRules.")

    if problems:
        createdStatus = "invalid-resource"
        createdStatusCode = "502"
        createdMessage = " ".join(problems)
        createdResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Created resource response validation failed", "details": problems}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        createdMoid = moid
        createdStatus = "ready"
        createdStatusCode = "200"
        createdMessage = "The entity-based alarm suppression resource was created and reports Enabled=true; current active state was not verified."
        createdResultJson = json.dumps({
            "Moid": moid,
            "Name": name,
            "Enabled": True,
            "Entity": {"Moid": expectedServerMoid, "ObjectType": expectedServerObjectType},
            "StartDate": payload.get("StartDate"),
            "EndDate": payload.get("EndDate"),
            "AlarmRulesIncluded": False,
            "ActiveStateVerified": False,
            "ActiveStateNote": "Enabled=true does not prove the suppression is currently active; StartDate scheduling and the service-managed system-enabled state also apply."
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    createdStatus = "helper-failure"
    createdStatusCode = "500"
    createdMessage = str(exc)
    createdResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Created alarm-suppression response inspection failed", "detail": createdMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
